thread:
maia: Heads-up: I'm kicking off a small docs PR to simplify the 'hello-runner' quickstart. Goal: make the sample runnable with one command, unify env var names across examples, and repair the SDK v9 reference. I'll push the files under examples/hello-runner and open a draft PR.

ryan: Nice. What's the single-command UX? We should keep the Docker option but make `npm start` the fastest path for newcomers.

maia: Exactly. Plan is `npm ci && npm run start` from the repo root after copying `.env.sample` -> `.env`. I'll add a tiny start wrapper so `npm run start` loads `.env` if present. Short snippets I'll add in the README:```bash
# .env.sample
RW_API_KEY=replace_me
RW_REGION=us-west1
```
and package.json script:```json
"scripts": {
  "start": "node ./examples/hello-runner/start.js"
}
```

claire: RW_API_KEY is fine. Can we include a one-line migrate hint for older examples that used API_TOKEN? Folks keep hitting that.

maia: Yes 94 will add a "Migration from legacy samples" subsection:": if you previously used API_TOKEN, set RW_API_KEY=API_TOKEN_VALUE or update your secret name in CI."

ryan: Also add a link check entry in docs CI please. Our last quickstart PR failed due to a 404 link to SDK docs.

maia: I'll point the SDK ref to https://sdk.redwood.ai/v9/quickstart and add a `docs:linkcheck` job to the PR pipeline. CI-bot, could you run the external link check on the draft?

ci-bot: queued: docs/linkcheck on PR draft. You'll get results as a check.

claire: For reviewers: @ryan please take CI changes, @maia handles sample code and start wrapper, I'll proof the text and update screenshots.

maia: Draft PR #4901 created. Description checklist: - add examples/hello-runner with start script - include .env.sample and migration note - update README quick run steps - point SDK link to v9 - add docs CI linkcheck step - add small smoke test to examples/test/smoke.test.js (asserts server returns 200 on /health)

ryan: I'll add the CI job: run linkcheck after the build, and run the examples smoke test. If linkcheck fails, fail the job.

maia: One minor change: the start script will prefer env vars from the environment over .env file so CI can inject secrets. Example in start.js:```js
require('dotenv').config();
const http = require('http');
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 8080;
http.createServer((req, res) => {
  res.end('hello runner');
}).listen(PORT, () => console.log('listening', PORT));
```

claire: Don't forget to add an accessibility-friendly screenshot caption and alt text.

maia: Added to PR checklist. Also noted small Dockerfile stanza to keep for on-prem docs.

ryan: Quick nit: use `RW_API_KEY` consistently in the examples repo search before merging. I can run a grep and list matches in the PR comments.

maia: Good call. I'll include grep output in the PR and will update any matches.

ci-bot: linkcheck: external links OK. examples smoke: failing at /health (404) in CI job.

maia: That failure is expected pre-fix 94 I pushed a fix to start.js and re-ran CI.

ci-bot: examples smoke: now passing. linkcheck: OK.

claire: Reviewing now. Small wording suggestion on the auth paragraph: prefer "token" over "key" in text but keep RW_API_KEY as the env var.

maia: Updated wording. Also added note: "If you rotate secrets, set the new secret under the same RW_API_KEY name in your CI provider."

ryan: LGTM from CI/ops side. Merge if docs review passes.

claire: Left two tiny copy edits. Once fixed, I'll approve.

maia: Addressed edits and pushed. Requesting final review.

claire: Approved.

maia: Merged PR #4901. Will add a short blurb in #announcements after the docs slice deploys. Thanks all!
